thread:
Kai: Heads up — I'm prototyping a 'rescue route' UX that prefers lower-cost model variants on client errors and only escalates to humans for sustained 5xx spikes. Sketching modes: safemode, throttle, reroute. Thoughts?

Maria: Love the name. How do we define triggers? We currently use HTTP status + latency buckets but need model-quality signals too (e.g., hallucination/regression).

Lee: Agree on quality triggers. Also: can this respect quota windows? If a customer is near committed capacity, switch to a cheaper variant automatically.

Kai: Yep. Draft config example (super rough):

```
policy {
  id: "rescue-1"
  mode: "reroute"
  triggers: ["5xx", "latency>300", "quality.regression>0.1"]
  fallback_target: "open-quant-v2"
  audit: "timeline"
}
```

Maria: Small naming nit: prefer fallback_target over reroute_target — clearer intent. Audit should include reason_code, sampled_input_hash, and decision_path.

DevOpsBot: deploy-preview:policy-service/PR-412 rolled to staging :thumbsup: https://ci/internal/PR-412

Sam: UX ask: console needs a per-policy timeline with sampled traces and an explainer 'why this decision was made'. Also a "simulate" toggle to run new policies against historical traces without impacting real traffic.

Lee: Add budget_sensitivity param so the policy can be cost-aware (e.g., avoid reroute if it increases egress/credits).

Kai: Telemetry proposal tags: rescue.policy_id, rescue.trigger, rescue.decision_path, rescue.sample_rate, rescue.fallback_target. Audit line should also surface operator_id when a manual override occurs.

Maria: Canary behavior — strongly +1 for dry_run:true by default for newly created policies so we gather telemetry before enforcement. That should be a console affordance.

Sam: Action items: (1) decide API field names (fallback_target vs reroute_target) — Kai to propose in proto, (2) console mock for policy timeline + simulate — Maria to draft, (3) telemetry + audit spec — Sam to draft.

Kai: I'll open a proto PR with both field names as comments and a migration note. Will add sample audit lines in the PR description.

Maria: I'll sketch a compact timeline wireframe (sampled traces on hover) and include a dry-run toggle state.

Lee: I'll start a short doc on cost/budget knobs to plug into policy config.

Sam: Sweet. If we can get the telemetry schema before next week we can start dry-run experiments on the staging trace dump.

Kai: Nice. Thanks all — posting notes to the design board and will link PR when ready.
